exposure: surgery by a general obstetrician and gynecologist
outcome: Lower urinary tract injury during hysterectomy
cohort: 405 women undergoing hysterectomy for benign disease
finding: Bladder injury at the time of benign hysterectomy is associated with a prior history of Cesarean section, total abdominal hysterectomy, and surgery by a general obstetrician and gynecologist, while ureteral injury is associated with laparoscopic-assisted vaginal hysterectomy and total abdominal hysterectomy.
mod_finding: A history of prior cesarean section was associated with bladder injury during benign hysterectomy.
